أَكْلَةٌ A single act of eating (S, Mgh, Msb, K) until one is satisfied. (S.) Hence the saying, المُعْتَادُ أَكْلَتَانِ الغَدَآءُ وَالعَشَآءُ, meaning That to which people are accustomed is two acts of eating, the eating of the morning-meal and that of the evening-meal. (Mgh.) ―
-b2- See also أُكْلَةٌ, in two places. ―
-b3- And see أُكُلٌ, first sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
